name: com.bun3.unity.window
description: Desktop-overlay window control for Windows: AlwaysOnTop (HWND_TOPMOST pinning with drift enforcement), WindowTransparency (DWM per-pixel alpha with color-key fallback), and ClickThrough (pointer-aware WS_EX_TRANSPARENT toggling). Fully static — configured via a WindowOverlaySettings asset in Resources and driven by one player-loop tick; no scene objects. Editor: always-on-top works on the editor window for play-mode testing; transparency and click-through are build-only. Non-Windows platforms are safe no-ops.

samples.description: Always-on-top + transparent + click-through overlay bootstrap, with a build verification checklist.
